limitations: Statistical confidence, not a deterministic exact response.
No particle/order/time/radius cutoff; work is actual transformed work.
Proved work bound grows as n^2; fast observed work is not a uniform theorem.
Rounded displayed confidence endpoints include an explicit numerical allowance.
confidence_correction: The original exploratory confidence calculation underallocated its four-tail failure budget and used midpoint variances without a full interval correction. These displayed intervals are diagnostic only. The separate certify_all_order.py uses four one-sided exact rational bounds on endpoint variables and supersedes them.
